recognize_zh: 視野中央一顆漿細胞：細胞核圓形、明顯偏向一側且染色質呈粗塊狀，細胞質豐富深藍，靠核旁有一塊較淡的核周淡染區（perinuclear hof）；在周邊血出現即應考慮漿細胞白血病。
features: Medium-sized oval cell with abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Round, markedly eccentric nucleus with coarse clumped chromatin
Pale perinuclear clearing (hof) in the cytoplasm adjacent to the nucleus
Red cells show overlapping and short stacks; occasional platelets
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows red cells with overlapping and short stacks and scattered platelets. A circulating plasma cell is present, with an oval outline, abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm, a round eccentric nucleus with coarse clumped chromatin, and a distinct pale perinuclear hof. No nucleoli or plasmablastic features are seen in this cell. With an absolute or relative circulating plasma cell count meeting diagnostic criteria, findings are consistent with plasma cell leukemia.

ddx.vs: Reactive peripheral plasma cells are sparse and polytypic for kappa/lambda, whereas plasma cell leukemia shows a clonal population above threshold.
LPL shows mostly small lymphocytes and plasmacytoid lymphocytes, typically with MYD88 L265P, rather than a monomorphous plasma cell population.
Reactive lymphocytes have more central nuclei, less clumped chromatin, and cytoplasm that hugs adjacent red cells without a defined hof.
